title: Deeper/broader peer provenance, scope, and native acceptance refresh
scope: Separate formal peer releases from current source heads and prerelease artifacts
Reconcile ACadSharp issue 1297 against existing MTEXT flag vectors and native acceptance gates
Refresh status and evidence limits for LibreDWG issues 1354, 1355, and 1361
Refine only existing comparator and composed native-acceptance checkpoints

sourceTypes: Official peer release pages and release notes
Primary GitHub issue pages and issue-index status
Local plan and existing fast-slice records
method.limitations: GitHub issues describe reporter-specific behavior and may be incomplete; mutable master/version labels and prerelease assets were inspected through GitHub pages, not independently downloaded, hashed, or executed. No inference is made that peer behavior is a libdxfrw defect.

sources.observed: Formal tagged baseline remains v3.8.0. It must remain distinct from mutable master observations.
The release page identifies v3.8.0 at 3a1c66b as latest and reports commits to master after the tag; current development source is not the same artifact as the released package.

sources.revision: Open issue checked 2026-10-17; report cites AutoCAD 2025 Core Console and ACadSharp master v3.8.14 / v3.8.0
sources.observed: Reporter says an AC1032 MTEXT with frame-only flag value 16 is rejected, value 17 opens, and AC1027 with value 16 opens. An AutoCAD-authored file read/written by ACadSharp is also rejected. The rewritten file omitted VisualStyle and section/detail view styles, but the reporter did not establish causality.

sources.revision: Release list reviewed 2026-10-17; latest visible prerelease 0.14.8612 at f860b0f, dated Oct. 13, marked Windows nightly
sources.observed: This prerelease is distinct from the 0.14.1 formal release baseline and is platform-specific. No binary was downloaded or run.
Used to cross-check the formal 0.14.1 release context; it does not make a nightly artifact equivalent to a formal release.

sources.revision: Issue status and report reviewed 2026-10-17; closed and linked to #1363; report observed at e405fcff / 0.14.8556
sources.observed: Reporter describes AC1021 LWPOLYLINE and other coordinate desynchronization on samples that also exhibited other decode errors. Closure does not qualify a current prerelease or demonstrate a local defect.

sources.revision: Open issue checked 2026-10-17; report observed at e405fcff / 0.14.8556
sources.observed: Reporter describes pre-R13 REPEAT/ENDREP/LOAD handling in LibreDWG conversion. These records are outside the current AC1012+ DWG support matrix; no expansion or speculative mapping is proposed.

Reporter describes a truncated DXF lacking ENTITIES/EOF with a zero process exit status. This is already covered by existing local output-closure and independent-readback plan owners, not a new local finding.

Existing generated AC1027/AC1032 MTEXT vectors cover values 0/16/17 and following-handle alignment; existing output closure, strict readback, peer matrix, and external support gates were refined without adding implementation work.

assessment.artifactProvenanceRule: Record formal release, prerelease, and moving source head separately. Pin exact artifact hash, platform, source revision, runtime, and operation before interpreting a peer result.
assessment.mtextRule: Keep generated 0/16/17 parser/writer vectors as structural evidence. At the existing composed native gate, hold the complete object inventory constant, record exact AC code and AutoCAD build, and capture audit/repair/deletion results before attributing behavior to one flag.
assessment.peerIssueRule: A peer issue/closure is a failure-shape or status signal, not a local defect or format rule. The old LibreDWG 0.14.8556 LWPOLYLINE report does not justify coordinate-magnitude heuristics; pre-R13 pseudo-record behavior stays outside current scope.
assessment.speedRule: No new per-slice test, peer install, external sample, native run, or CTest registration. Continue existing focused implementation slices; perform native/peer comparison only at the composed checkpoint.
assessment.fixtureRule: Do not add peer-provided issue attachments. If a later local control is justified, generate it in memory or from scratch in a temporary directory.

evidenceLimits: ACadSharp #1297 does not isolate MTEXT group-90 flag semantics from whole-file writer/object-inventory differences.
LibreDWG #1361 is linked to a closure item but its historical sample route was not independently reproduced against current source or binaries.
LibreDWG #1354 concerns pre-R13 records outside the current local DWG version matrix.
Peer issue reports, release notes, and feature declarations do not establish libdxfrw behavior, native semantics, or support claims.
All six external qualification items remain deferred and non-promoting.
